summary: Part 2 of 4 of training video 1.1 (Onboarding App, Seller), 06:24 to 09:50. The trainer fills in the seller onboarding form in an AppSheet app (New Slice Form), explains the seller agreement (a Google Doc titled 'Revibe Seller Agreement - March 2025' to read, complete, sign, download as PDF and upload back to the form) and the quality guidelines (a Drive PDF with grade tables). All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened. Frame-to-content mapping was corrected where the pack cited the wrong frame. The agreement placeholders and signature block stay unfilled on screen. Some screens and narration disagree (grade names, camera limits, two different quality-guideline links), and those points are listed as unclear rather than stated as facts.

evidence.quote: 9.1 The Seller warrants that the Products provided to Revibe are in good working condition. 9.2 The Seller provides a '6-Month Warranty' on all Products sold through Revibe, effective from the date of delivery to the end customer. 9.3 The warranty shall cover repair, replacement, or refund of the Product within 5 working days from the date of receiving the Product, if it fails to meet the specifications.

facts.statement: Non-compliance penalty (11.6): if a customer complaint about receiving an order without Revibe's standard packing is confirmed, and either the seller did not notify Revibe of a packing material shortage or the seller still had Revibe packing stock, the seller is penalised 200 AED per complaint.

evidence.quote: 11.6 Non-Compliance Penalty: If a customer files a complaint about receiving an order without Revibe's standard packing... A penalty of 200 AED will be applied to the Seller for each such complaint.

facts.statement: If the seller runs out of Revibe's packing materials, the seller must notify Revibe immediately. Until Revibe restocks, the seller may ship with alternative packing materials.

evidence.quote: If the Seller runs out of Revibe's packing materials, they must notify Revibe immediately. Until Revibe restocks, the Seller is permitted to ship using alternative packing materials.

facts.statement: Quality guidelines (11.7): the seller agrees to comply with the quality guidelines and to implement quality check processes that align with them.

evidence.quote: 11.7 Quality guidelines: The Seller agrees to comply with the quality guidelines outlined below and to implement quality check processes in alignment with these standards.

facts.statement: Score principle (12.1): the score given to a seller must reflect the seller's operational performance and allow the seller to assume a price positioning against its competitors, in line with the quality and operational excellence offered to customers.

evidence.quote: The score given to a seller must: Reflect his operational performance; Allow him to assume a price positioning vs. its competitors in line with the quality and operational excellence offered to customers

facts.statement: The seller's score may vary between -5% and +5%. Sellers get access to a Performance and Score sheet that shows their live performance and how the score is calculated.

evidence.quote: Seller's score may vary between -5% and +5% and sellers get access to a Performance and Score sheet detailing their live performance and how their score is calculated.

facts.statement: Account suspension (12.2): if the seller's score reflects bad operational performance, Revibe reserves the right to suspend the seller's account. The seller can then no longer ship orders independently, and the only option is to send products to Revibe's warehouse.

evidence.quote: Revibe reserves the right to suspend the Seller's account. In such a case, the Seller shall no longer be permitted to ship orders independently, and the only available option will be to send products to Revibe's warehouse

facts.statement: Per clause 12.2, the suspension measure is meant to let the seller reduce order volume, refocus on quality, lower the claim rate and ensure timely shipments while making the operational improvements needed to resume independent shipping.

evidence.quote: This measure allows the Seller to reduce order volume, refocus on quality, lower the claim rate, and ensure timely shipments while implementing the necessary operational improvements to resume independent shipping.

facts.statement: Communication (clause 13 in the agreement, with its clause numbered 12.1): the seller keeps an active line of communication with Revibe and notifies Revibe immediately of any stock issues or delays in fulfilling orders.

evidence.quote: The Seller shall maintain an active line of communication with Revibe and notify Revibe immediately if there are any stock issues or delays in fulfilling Orders.

facts.statement: Termination (clause 14, with its clauses numbered 13.1 and 13.2): either party may terminate with 30 days written notice. If the other party breaches the agreement, the non-breaching party may terminate immediately on written notice.

evidence.quote: This Agreement may be terminated by either Party by providing a 30-day written notice to the other Party. ... may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice.

facts.statement: Amendments (clause 15, with its clauses numbered 14.1 and 14.2): amendments must be made in writing and signed by both parties, and become a binding part of the agreement once signed.

evidence.quote: Any amendments to this Agreement must be made in writing and signed by both Parties. Once signed, any amendments become a binding part of this Agreement.

facts.statement: Governing law (clause 16, with its clauses numbered 15.1 and 15.2): the agreement is governed by the laws of Dubai, UAE. Disputes go to arbitration in the Dubai International Financial Centre before a single arbitrator.

evidence.quote: governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Dubai, United Arab Emirates ... arbitration in the Dubai International Financial Center, with a single arbitrator.

facts.statement: Entire agreement (clause 17, with its clauses numbered 16.1 and 16.2): the agreement replaces all prior agreements, oral or written. Any modification must be in writing and signed by both parties.

evidence.quote: This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties and supersedes all prior agreements, oral or written. Any modifications to this Agreement must be in writing and signed by both Parties.

facts.statement: The agreement's signatures section (18) names Revibe Technology FZ LLC, with Name: Abdessamad Benzakour, as the Revibe signer. The seller's name, representative name, position and effective date are left as red placeholders.

evidence.quote: Revibe Technology FZ LLC / Name: Abdessamad Benzakour / [Seller Name] / Name: [Seller Representative Name] / Position: [Seller Position] / Date: [Effective Date]

unclear.issue: Narration says the technicians choice runs 'from zero to plus {ten?}', but the screen only shows the selected value 3 - 5. The full option list is not visible, so the range is not confirmed.
The daily-orders options overlap at their ends (0 - 5 and 5 - 10 share 5; 10 - 20 and 20 - 30 share 20). The screen does not say which band an exact value such as 5, 10 or 20 falls into.
The 'Who ? Please mention the business name' label has no required asterisk, while other required fields show one. Whether the field is mandatory is not shown on screen.

The signature block shows four lines ([Seller Name], Name: [Seller Representative Name], Position: [Seller Position], Date: [Effective Date]). The narration lists five items (name, name of the business, personal name, position, date). How these map to the lines is not shown.
The signature block is still unfilled in every frame, so it is not shown whether the agreement was signed on screen. The narration says to sign it, but the signing step is not shown.
The frames show the File (Fichier) menu label being hovered but not the menu items or the PDF download. The download step itself is not shown completing.
Narration says to 'change here the date'. Clause 2.1 defines the Effective Date as the date the agreement is signed by both parties. What the seller should enter as the date is not stated.

The grade names differ across sources. The form offers A+, A, B, C and Other. The guidelines table uses Excellent, Very good and Good. The narration says 'three grades excellent very good and good'. No mapping between these sets is shown.
The narration says some product is sold as 'new', but no 'New' grade appears in the form's grade list or in the guidelines table. Whether 'new' is a grade is not confirmed.

Camera limits conflict on page 1. The 'Camera dot' row (t00562, t00567) says Excellent None and Very good 1 small maximum, Good 2 small maximum. The 'Cameras (checked with portrait mode)' row (t00567, t00573) says Excellent max 1 small camera dot accepted and Very good and Good max 2 small camera dots accepted. Which limit applies is not clear.
The Body row shows the word 'Small' under the text for Very good and Good. Its meaning is not explained (frame t00562).
The Ports row on page 1 is partly hidden by the page counter overlay. Only the words '...battery, USB, ethernet, must be functional' are readable (frame t00579).

The narration says 'the kind of LCD we want us to offer', but the screens use the term Display (page 1 Display row) and Original & DD (page 2). Which row the trainer means is not stated, and the sentence is cut off at the end of the pack.

Page 2 grid: 'GW' and 'DD' are not defined. The mapping of the red cross and green check to the Excellent / Very good and Good sub-rows, and of the arrows to the two tables below, is not labelled on screen. The interpretation in the facts is medium confidence only.

Two different quality-guidelines links appear. The form (t00536, t00538, t00556) points to drive.google.com/file/d/1ELqeY-KOlnhFMylMpLEWPSSrrvfQuOGL/view?usp=sharing. Agreement clause 11.7 (t00498) points to drive.google.com/file/d/1mpW2oLLHNOoMQOCKBZK6yYjasIDqPcxE/view?usp=sharing. Which one is current is not stated. The characters in both IDs were read from small text, so they may be misread.
Clause 8.1 for KSA orders says Revibe bears the return shipping 'with a fee equivalent to 20% of the order value + 150 AED'. The screen does not say who pays this fee or which way it is charged.

Numbering in the agreement is inconsistent. Clause 3.2 appears twice (pricing and 48-hour shipping). From section 13 onward, clause numbers lag their headings (13 Communication has clause 12.1; 14 Termination has 13.1 and 13.2; 15 Amendments has 14.1 and 14.2; 16 Governing Law has 15.1 and 15.2; 17 Entire Agreement has 16.1 and 16.2).

Agreement sections 5 (Invoicing and Payment), 6 (VAT Responsibilities), 10 (Disputes) and clauses 11.1 to 11.5 are listed in the outline or cut off, and are not visible in these frames. They are not extracted here.
The screen does not show which file formats or sizes the upload accepts. The trainer says to download as PDF, and the file that was uploaded is named '...docx.pdf'.
The 'Have you read the quality guidelines ?' toggle is left on 'Not yet' in the frames. The trainer does not say whether the seller must change it to Yes, or what happens next.
Application status stays 'Application incomplete' in the frames shown. What makes it complete, and who reviews it, is not shown.
The first form field above the units question (chip 'Amazon') has no visible label in the frames, because the top of the panel is cut off.

Quality guidelines clause 11.7 (in the agreement) and the form's quality guidelines block link to two different Drive files, so one of them may be an old version.

privacy.what: The business name 'Device + LLC' is typed into the form as an example. It is a business name, not a real seller's personal data, but it should be checked before the material is shown to sellers.

The agreement's signature block names a Revibe representative (Abdessamad Benzakour) for Revibe Technology FZ LLC. This is a Revibe staff name, not seller data. It is recorded here only so the material can be reviewed before wider use.
No seller personal data (names, phone numbers, emails or home addresses) appears on screen. The seller fields are blank red placeholders.

The macOS file picker shows personal file names in the Music and Téléchargements folders (for example 'Capture d'écran à 9.05.36 AM', 'Covers', 'Tracks', and a Downloads file named '209926_DHL...'). These are not seller data and are not extracted.
